name: brreg-snap
description: Browser extension (Firefox + Chrome) that shows who is behind the site you're on, straight from Brønnøysundregistrene.

scripts.dev:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.dev:chrome: pnpm run build:chrome && web-ext run -t chromium --source-dir dist-chrome
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename "brreg-snap-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest --ignore-files "**/*.map"
scripts.package:chrome: pnpm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist-chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename "brreg-snap-chrome-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest --ignore-files "**/*.map"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:fast && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run verify:dist && pnpm run lint:ext
